description: NaLiCoPO₄F is Aluminum carbonitride-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.44 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.36 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to four O and one F atom to form distorted LiO₄F trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent CoO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.01-2.44 Å. The Li-F bond length is 2.10 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three O and one F atom. There is one shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.08 Å) Li-O bond lengths. The Li-F bond length is 1.86 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form CoO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent CoO₄F₂ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent LiO₄F trigonal bipyramids. There are two shorter (2.05 Å) and two longer (2.17 Å) Co-O bond lengths. Both Co-F bond lengths are 2.10 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form CoO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₄F trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent CoO₄F₂ octahedra. There are two shorter (2.09 Å) and two longer (2.11 Å) Co-O bond lengths. Both Co-F bond lengths are 2.15 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LiO₄F trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-56°. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.57 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four CoO₄F₂ octahedra and corners with two equivalent LiO₄F trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.59 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Co, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiCoP trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂LiP tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONaLiCoP trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂LiCo₂ trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Li, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂LiP tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FNa₂LiCo₂ trigonal bipyramids and corners with four equivalent ONaLiCoP trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Co and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Li, two equivalent Co, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Co, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Li, and two equivalent Co atoms to form distorted FNa₂LiCo₂ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂LiP tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent FNa₂LiCo₂ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONaLiCoP trigonal pyramids. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Li and two equivalent Co atoms.
